summary: Iteration 3 re-verification of the credential-leak fix plus full regression. Added /app/backend/tests/test_verify_before_write.py (44 cases) and re-ran the whole suite: 135 passed / 6 skipped (test_webhook_replay.py skips once SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is removed; it was temporarily set, all 6 signed-webhook replay/idempotency/order-safety cases passed, then the key and a backend restart restored the file). CRITICAL FIX CONFIRMED: verify-then-write holds under abuse. Bogus POST /api/admin/connections/shopify returns 400 in well under 1s (whole 44-case suite runs in ~10s, so no 35s retry storm), and /app/backend/.env never gains SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN / SHOPIFY_ADMIN_API_TOKEN under: single bogus submit, 6x failed-attempt loop, curl --max-time 0.5/1/2 client aborts, 3x browser navigate-away mid-request, and 4-way concurrent POSTs (shopify + gsc + bigquery + crawl-settings). After every attempt GET /api/admin/connections still reports shopify.verified false, admin_token_configured false, shop_domain null. Same holds for GSC (invalid JSON, fake private key, missing client_email -> 400/422, no GSC_* key, no key material in the body) and BigQuery. No shpat_ / BEGIN PRIVATE KEY / marker strings anywhere in responses, /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log, the audit rows (connection.shopify_failed / gsc_failed metadata is sanitised) or the DB. activate-live still refuses with 'These connections have never verified: shopify, gsc' and LIVE_DATA_MODE is never written; /api/meta/mode stays DEMO / live_data_mode false. Atomic env writes verified with 6 concurrent crawl-settings POSTs: no managed key lost, no duplicate keys, no empty KEY="" placeholders, 0600 preserved. Settings freshness verified (crawl/status reflects a new rate with no restart; connections and the acceptance report agree on data_mode). Job failure redaction verified: shopify_full_sync (background=false) records 'SourceUnavailable: Shopify credentials are not configured' in agent_activity with no Bearer/shpat_ pattern. RBAC granularity verified: analyst@urbandotted.com is 403 on all 10 admin-only POSTs and on GET /api/audit, and 200 on /overview, /opportunities, /admin/connections, /admin/live-acceptance-report and POST /api/pipelines/{recompute_opportunities|detect_anomalies}/run. Live-only endpoints (shopify sync/reconcile, gsc bootstrap/daily, crawl robots/batch/full) all fail cleanly with no 500. Acceptance report has all 13 sections, zero live counts, ready_for_stage1_acceptance false with a blocking list. Stage 1 invariants intact (0 PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes, all_write_policies_deny true, executor no_op_logger, empty write scopes, execute returns executed:false / STAGE_1_WRITES_DISABLED / DENY). Frontend: conn-metric-* cards read 'Not set' before and after failed submits (never 'Verified'), the Shopify button shows the 'Verifying with Shopify…' spinner while pending, the query refetches on error, the purge gate requires the literal 'PURGE' (disabled on empty and on lowercase 'purge', enabled on PURGE) and CANCEL closed it without purging. Regression sweep passed: Overview, AU + NZ war rooms, Opportunities evidence drawer, Keywords drawer, Technical issue drawer, Cost (force 100% -> 'Paid calls blocked: true', then Clear test charges -> 'Removed 1 test charges', spend back to $1.94), AI Operations all four tabs, audit/verify valid (2370 entries, chain valid). Cleanup done: 0 webhook_events, 0 budget_exhaustion_test ledger rows, 0 connection_state rows, 1200 DEMO products intact, .env identical to the original apart from key ordering (no Shopify/GSC/BigQuery keys, LIVE_DATA_MODE absent, CRAWL_REQUESTS_PER_SEC back to 3.0).

minor.issue: A failed synchronous job returns HTTP 200 with body status='failed'. Not a 500 and the error string is redacted, but a client cannot detect failure from the status code alone (consider 502/409 for foreground failures).

The backend OpenAPI schema is not reachable through the public ingress (the SPA is served at /openapi.json and /api/openapi.json is 404), so the 'zero write routes' invariant can only be audited from the internal port or via the acceptance report's stage1_invariants block.

Concurrent writes are last-writer-wins at the file level: the persisted rate can differ from the value in the newest 200 response (observed 2.5 persisted while a later request asked for 2.0). No key loss, but the response is not authoritative under concurrency.
Expected SourceUnavailable job failures are logged with a full traceback to backend.err.log (37 occurrences). Content is redacted, but it is noise that hides real faults.

issues: The GSC 'Service account JSON' textarea is plain text (panel copy claims 'this field is a secret input') so the private key is visible on screen; the Shopify token and GSC JSON fields also retain the submitted credential in the input value after a failed submit. Nothing leaks into rendered text, response panels or toasts, but clearing secret fields after submit and masking the JSON field would close the shoulder-surfing/DOM-inspection gap.
React console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - a select option renders a span; harmless today but will break hydration.

action_items: Optional hardening: clear the Shopify token / GSC service-account inputs after submit and render the GSC JSON field as a masked secret input (it currently shows the private key in cleartext).
Consider returning a non-200 status for foreground job failures (POST /api/admin/*?background=false currently returns 200 with status='failed').
Expose the backend OpenAPI schema under /api (e.g. /api/openapi.json) so the zero-write-route invariant is auditable through the public ingress.
Fix the React warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in the select that renders option content.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.connect_shopify/connect_gsc/connect_bigquery now construct the source with the candidate credentials and only call secret_store.write_secrets after verify() succeeds - the leak window from iteration 2 is closed and confirmed unreachable by abort/navigate-away/concurrency.
secrets.write_secrets is correctly atomic (temp file + os.replace under a threading lock) and removes keys instead of leaving KEY="" placeholders; 0600 is re-applied after replace.
services/jobs.py routes failure strings through secrets.redact() before persisting to agent_activity.error - verified clean in /api/agents/activity.
activate_live gates on the persisted connection_state table, so a restart cannot re-open the LIVE flip; verified refusal message and no LIVE_DATA_MODE write.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows exercised loaded and behaved as specified

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Transient: one budget_exhaustion_test ledger charge via the Cost screen (removed with 'Clear test charges'), signed webhook_events rows during the replay run (0 remaining), and bogus connection attempts that only produced audit rows.
test_credentials: admin@urbandotted.com / Stage1Admin!2026 (admin); analyst@urbandotted.com / Stage1Analyst!2026 (analyst: read + run_pipeline). Both work; /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not yet list the analyst fixture user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already adds -n loadscope). New file: tests/test_verify_before_write.py - it asserts the verify-before-write contract, .env key absence after every failure path, analyst RBAC, atomic crawl-settings writes and settings freshness; it reads the OpenAPI schema from http://localhost:8001/openapi.json because the public ingress serves the SPA at /openapi.json. Cost RBAC endpoints are /api/cost/override and /api/cost/simulate-exhaustion (NOT under /admin). RUNNABLE pipeline job names include recompute_opportunities, detect_anomalies, detect_cannibalization, classify_intents. Acceptance-report keys are catalogue.products / catalogue.demo_rows_still_present (no live_products key) and mode lives at the top level as data_mode. test_webhook_replay.py auto-skips unless SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is in /app/backend/.env (append, restart backend, run, remove, restart). Live ingestion is still untestable - no real Shopify/GSC credentials.
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects. The iteration-2 critical finding (credential written before verification, left behind on rollback failure) is resolved by injecting candidate credentials into the source constructors and writing to .env only after verify() returns; the non-retryable fast-fail in sources._gql removes the 35s window that made the race observable. All abuse paths (client abort, navigate-away, concurrency, repeated failures) now leave the env file untouched.
